text.p: These are the leading stories in the Nambian press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Seventy-three San (bushmen) protesters appeared in court on Monday after they blocked two entrance gates to the Etosha National Game Park on Sunday in protest against the dispossesion of their ancestral land.
- Prospects for more rain in Namibia in the coming days are looking good.
- More than 60 San demonstraters were teargassed and arrested at Okaukuejo near Etosha on Sunday after the community unsuccesfully tried to raise their concerns with President Sam Nujoma.
